note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate, soldier and worker are described; synonymy citations, distribution records and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule light brown to brown; nasus brown to dark brown; antennae dark straw yellow to brown; pronotum brown; legs dark straw yellow; abdominal tergites light brown to brown, sternites paler. Head covered with minute hairs, with a pair of long setae on vertex and a pair near base of nasus; pronotum densely covered with short hairs; each abdominal tergite with one long hair on each side and minute hairs elsewhere; sternites densely hairy. Body length 3.30–4.10 mm. Head capsule pyriform (1.36–1.50 mm long including nasus, 0.83–0.95 mm long excluding nasus, 0.89–0.95 mm maximum width). Nasus short, conical (0.53–0.57 mm long, nasus length/head length index 0.58–0.61). Antennae 12–13-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2, or longer and wider. Mandibles vestigial, each with a short spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.18–0.22 mm long, 0.40–0.45 mm wide); anterior margin rounded, without notch; posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to yellow; antennae, labrum and legs slightly paler; abdominal tergites light brown, sternites pale yellow. Pilosity of head and body moderate. Body length 3.50–4.50 mm. Head capsule subcircular (0.85–0.90 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.00–1.08 mm maximum width); Y-shaped suture faintly visible. Fontanelle plate slightly long, translucent. Antennae 14-segmented; segments 2 and 3 subequal in length. Postclypeus light brown, hairy, inflated; far less than 1/2 as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.25 mm long, 0.50–0.55 mm wide); anterior margin weakly notched.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule brown; antennae light brown; labrum and postclypeus straw yellow; pronotum dark straw yellow; legs light brown; abdominal tergites slightly paler than head, sternites nearly white. Head and body densely covered with long and short hairs. Body length 10.90–11.60 mm with wings, 5.60–6.90 mm without wings. Head capsule subquadrate (0.75–1.00 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.15–1.20 mm wide including compound eyes); coronal suture faintly visible, its median arm fairly distinct in the specimens examined. Fontanelle plate narrow and long, translucent. Compound eyes large, protruding, broadly circular (0.35–0.40 mm maximum diameter). Ocelli elliptical, translucent, separated from compound eye by slightly less than their short diameter (long diameter 0.13–0.18 mm, short diameter 0.085 mm, compound eye–ocellus distance 0.06–0.08 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 as long as segments 2 and 4 but narrower than both; segment 5 shorter than segment 4. Postclypeus inflated, hairy; less than 1/2 as long as wide. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal, anterior part slightly upturned (0.40–0.53 mm long, 0.90–0.95 mm wide); anterior margin wavy with a distinct median notch; posterior margin also distinctly notched. Wings greyish brown, densely hairy; anterior margin with small scale-like processes (4–5 rows), those on posterior margin slightly coarser (6 rows); wing membrane with fine non-stellate spinules; forewing 9.2–10.8 mm long, hindwing 9.0–9.30 mm long.
